# Blue Roster Design System

> Rules, tokens, components, patterns, and screen specs for building Blue Roster UI from the Figma Design System Legacy file. Say Blue Roster, Blue Roster Legacy, or BR and follow the playbook below.

### Playbook

Follow this playbook when the request says **Blue Roster**, **Blue Roster Legacy**, or **BR**.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and `tokens/` before writing UI (`tokens.css`, `tokens.json`, and the markdown tables).
2. Map the request to the closest spec in `screens/` and state which file you are following. Use the keyword table. If several rows match, pick one view and say why.
3. Build mobile first: **390**, then **768**, then **desktop**. Admin specs are drawn at 1440×900. If the chosen spec has no 390 or 768 frame, flag that gap instead of inventing a layout.
4. Colors use only `br/*` tokens, through the CSS variables in `tokens/tokens.css` (`--br-...`, slash becomes hyphen). Spacing, radius, and type use the variables in that same file (`--spacing`, `--radius-*`, `--text-*`, `--font-weight-*`). No hard-coded hex, rgb, or px where a token exists.
5. Use only components documented in `components/`. Calendars, timelines, agenda, and schedulers use Mobiscroll (`br-mobiscroll` and `br-mobiscroll-*`).
6. Filters: **1–3** stay inline (one row on desktop). **4+** go in one `br-filter-dialog`, opened by `br-filter-button`.
7. Deliver **Light and Dark**. Light is `:root`; Dark is `[data-theme="dark"]`.
8. Flag gaps instead of inventing components, tokens, states, copy, or behavior. Unknown items stay `TBD`.
9. Build **one view first** and ask for review before the next view.

#### Keyword → spec

Keywords are request language. Each spec path is a file in `screens/`.

| Keywords | Spec |
|---|---|
| screen index, list of screens, qué pantallas | `screens/README.md` |
| action center, action center live, centro de acción | `screens/admin/action-center.md` |
| action center requests, requests tab | `screens/admin/action-center-requests.md` |
| catalogs user, user catalog, usuarios | `screens/admin/catalogs-user.md` |
| gantt production, production schedule, producción | `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` |
| gantt, projection, gantt projection | `screens/admin/gantt.md` |
| history, assignment history, historial de asignaciones | `screens/admin/history-assignments.md` |
| roles, roles management | `screens/admin/roles.md` |
| base model, modelo base, roster catalogs base model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-base-model.md` |
| model catalog, roster catalogs model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-model.md` |
| pattern catalog, patrón, roster catalogs pattern | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-pattern.md` |
| shift catalog, turno, roster catalogs shift | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-shift.md` |
| rosters list, rosters tab | `screens/admin/rosters-rosters.md` |
| rosters assignment, assignment planning | `screens/admin/rosters.md` |
| sign in, login, iniciar sesión | `screens/admin/sign-in.md` |
| workload engine | `screens/admin/workload-engine.md` |
| workload template, plantilla | `screens/admin/workload-template.md` |
| employee profile, perfil, profile desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/employee-profile-desktop.md` |
| my schedule desktop, agenda desktop, schedule desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/my-schedule-desktop-proposal.md` |
| overtime desktop, overtime filters desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/overtime-opportunities-desktop-filters.md` |
| avatar, language, notifications, nav drawer, idioma, notificaciones, menú | `screens/employee-mobile/global-overlays-avatar-menu-language-notifications-nav-drawer.md` |
| multi-employee calendar, team calendar on mobile, team schedule mobile, ver empleados en móvil, calendario de empleados móvil, calendario del equipo | **No spec yet. Stop and ask the user.** Offer `screens/admin/gantt.md` / `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` (desktop admin Gantt) as reference and the My Schedule mobile specs for styling; do not invent the layout. |
| agenda, schedule, my schedule, day, día, calendario | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md` |
| my schedule month, month, mes | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-month.md` |
| my schedule week, week, semana | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-week.md` |
| overtime approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-approvals.md` |
| overtime, overtime opportunities, horas extra | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-opportunities.md` |
| sick time history, sick history | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-history.md` |
| sick time, sick request | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-request.md` |
| time off approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-approvals.md` |
| time off, time off request | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-request.md` |

Disambiguation: "agenda" or "my schedule" with no Day, Week, or Month, and no desktop, maps to `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md`. "Overtime" with no Approvals maps to Opportunities. Desktop or Admin in the request wins over the mobile row. State the chosen spec before building.

"My schedule" means the signed-in employee's own calendar. A request to see **several employees** (team, crew, roster, empleados) on mobile has **no spec**: say so, ask, and offer the Gantt desktop spec as reference.

Visual references for that playbook:

- Event colors on screen are in `tokens/events.md`. Shift uses `--br-event-shift-neutral` (neutral gray). Tasks uses `--br-event-shift` (solid primary, white text). Overtime uses `--br-event-overtime`. Planned overtime uses `--br-special-4` (`#5a2ead`). Leave uses `--br-event-leave`. Do not color a Shift with `--br-event-shift`.
- Time and date copy is in `patterns/formats.md` (12-hour `6 AM`, `Thu 8 Oct 2026`). Calendar geometry is in `patterns/calendar-layout.md` (48px per hour, overlapping events side by side).
- Logos, avatar initials, and badges are in `assets/`. Sample schedule data for mockups is in `fixtures/schedule.json`.
- Non-Angular mockups start from `starter/` (`br-m.css`, `components.html`, `my-schedule-day.html`). Production UI still uses the Angular `br-*` components.

### Token summary

Colors below are the key semantic `br/*` tokens. CSS variable = `--` plus the token name with `/` replaced by `-`. Dark cells say "same" when `[data-theme="dark"]` does not override the Light value.

| Token | CSS variable | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| `br/primary` | `--br-primary` | `#1e75f6` | `#6ea3ff` |
| `br/primary-dark` | `--br-primary-dark` | `#064db7` | `#4e81da` |
| `br/primary-darkest` | `--br-primary-darkest` | `#002458` | `#345287` |
| `br/primary-light` | `--br-primary-light` | `#8ebafa` | same |
| `br/primary-lightest` | `--br-primary-lightest` | `#c7ddfd` | same |
| `br/on-primary` | `--br-on-primary` | `#ffffff` | same |
| `br/contrast` | `--br-contrast` | `#ffffff` | `#121621` |
| `br/contrast-inverted` | `--br-contrast-inverted` | `#000000` | `#ffffff` |
| `br/neutral` | `--br-neutral` | `#535353` | `#b4b4b9` |
| `br/neutral-dark` | `--br-neutral-dark` | `#111827` | `#c8cdd7` |
| `br/neutral-darkest` | `--br-neutral-darkest` | `#121212` | `#f5f6f8` |
| `br/neutral-light` | `--br-neutral-light` | `#d1d5db` | `#373c4b` |
| `br/neutral-lightest` | `--br-neutral-lightest` | `#f2f4f8` | `#1e2230` |
| `br/neutral-white` | `--br-neutral-white` | `#f9f9f9` | `#161a26` |
| `br/component-fill` | `--br-component-fill` | `#f5f5f5` | `#1e2230` |
| `br/divider` | `--br-divider` | `#00000000` | `#ffffff1f` |
| `br/semantic1` | `--br-semantic1` | `#1c9646` | same |
| `br/semantic2` | `--br-semantic2` | `#ef4444` | same |
| `br/semantic3` | `--br-semantic3` | `#f59e0b` | same |
| `br/special-4` | `--br-special-4` | `#5a2ead` | same |

On-screen event blocks (`tokens/events.md`). No border. Text is `--br-neutral-darkest` for Shift and `--br-on-primary` for the other four.

| Event | Background token | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shift | `--br-event-shift-neutral` | `#d1d5db` | `#373c4b` |
| Tasks | `--br-event-shift` | `#1e75f6` | `#6ea3ff` |
| Overtime | `--br-event-overtime` | `#1c9646` | `#1c9646` |
| Planned overtime | `--br-special-4` | `#5a2ead` | `#5a2ead` |
| Leave | `--br-event-leave` | `#ef4444` | `#ef4444` |

Type scale (Light = Dark): `--text-xs` 12px, `--text-sm` 14px, `--text-base` 16px, `--text-lg` 18px, `--text-xl` 20px, `--text-2xl` 24px, `--text-5xl` 48px. Weights: `--font-weight-normal` 400, `--font-weight-medium` 500, `--font-weight-semibold` 600, `--font-weight-bold` 700, `--font-weight-extrabold` 800. Typeface is Roboto.

Spacing: `--spacing` 4px. That is the only spacing step in `tokens/spacing.md`.

Radius (Light = Dark): `--radius-md` 6px, `--radius-lg` 8px, `--radius-2xl` 16px. Event blocks use 4px, which is `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)` because no radius token is 4.

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/AGENTS.md): Build rules and the playbook for Blue Roster, Blue Roster Legacy, and BR.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/CLAUDE.md): Pointer for Claude Code. Read AGENTS.md first.

## Tokens

- [tokens/events.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/events.md): On-screen event colors. Shift is neutral gray, Tasks is solid primary, Planned overtime is br/special-4.
- [tokens/radius.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/radius.md): Radius tokens radius/md, radius/lg, radius/2xl.
- [tokens/semantic-br.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/semantic-br.md): Semantic br/* colors with Light and Dark values.
- [tokens/spacing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/spacing.md): Spacing base unit (4px) and related layout tokens.
- [tokens/tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/tokens.css): CSS variables. Light on :root, Dark on [data-theme=dark].
- [tokens/tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/tokens.json): All Figma variables from collection s2d, with aliases and resolved values.
- [tokens/typography.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/typography.md): Type scale, font weights, and the Roboto styles used on screen.

## Patterns

- [patterns/calendar-layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/patterns/calendar-layout.md): Calendar geometry: 48px per hour, side-by-side overlaps, week strip, month grid, scroll.
- [patterns/formats.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/patterns/formats.md): Date, time, and copy formats as drawn (12-hour 6 AM, Thu 8 Oct 2026).

## Starter

- [starter/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/README.md): Plain HTML/CSS starter for non-Angular mockups. Production still uses Angular br-* components.
- [starter/_verify/compare-dark.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/_verify/compare-dark.png): Side-by-side check, Dark: Figma export beside the starter render.
- [starter/_verify/compare-light.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/_verify/compare-light.png): Side-by-side check, Light: Figma export beside the starter render.
- [starter/br-m.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/br-m.css): Mobile component classes. Imports tokens.css. Colors only through var(--br-*).
- [starter/components.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/components.html): Gallery of copy-paste markup for every starter snippet. Add ?theme=dark for Dark.
- [starter/my-schedule-day.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/starter/my-schedule-day.html): My Schedule Day page built from the starter snippets and the calendar-layout measurements.
